lines.trans: Here we are, we have arrived in front of your place.
Thank you for this very lovely evening.
Well, it is late now.
Time passes very quickly with you.
Yes, I had an excellent time.
I must get going now.
Do you have a long day tomorrow?
Yes, I have a lot of work at the agency.
Then you must rest well.
You too, rest well.

examples.text: Cette agence ne représente que des stars.

meanings.note: une agence artistique = a talent agency

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: aller + infinitive: tu vas l'agacer = you're going to annoy her
ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?
to draw a conclusion or move on

examples.text: Appelle Clémentine. Dis-lui que je ne peux pas venir ce soir.
examples.trans: Call Clémentine. Tell her I can't come tonight.

meanings.note: je peux t'appeler? = can I call you?

examples.text: Tout le monde en place pour cet après-midi.
examples.trans: Everyone in place for this afternoon.

examples.text: Je veux réussir ma scène cet après-midi.
examples.trans: I want to succeed in my scene this afternoon.

meanings.note: invariable in the plural; cet après-midi = this afternoon

examples.text: Non, je viens d'arriver. Mon père, mais c'est compliqué.
examples.trans: No, I've just arrived. My dad, but it's complicated.

meanings.note: je viens d'arriver = I've just arrived

examples.text: Tu déjeunes aussi avec Dany Boon.
examples.trans: You're also having lunch with Dany Boon.

examples.text: Tu déjeunes aussi avec Dany Boon demain.
examples.trans: You're also having lunch with Dany Boon tomorrow.

examples.text: Et demain, tu déjeunes avec Audiard.
examples.trans: And tomorrow you're having lunch with Audiard.

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: avoir peur = to be afraid, avoir raison = to be right, avoir 40 ans = to be 40
elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.text: Tu n'aimais pas Mandelieu? C'est un bel endroit.
examples.trans: Didn't you like Mandelieu? It's a lovely place.

meanings.note: before the noun; bel before a vowel: un bel endroit

examples.trans: You know a lot of people.

examples.text: Tu connais beaucoup de monde dans le cinéma. Tu pourrais m'aider.
examples.trans: You know lots of people in film. You could help me.

meanings.note: beaucoup de + noun, with no article: beaucoup de travail

meanings.en: beaucoup de = a lot of, many

meanings.note: as a masculine noun: pour le bien de = for the good of
as a masculine noun: pour le bien de = for the good of
as an interjection: bon, alors... = right, so...
as an interjection: bon, alors... = right, so...

meanings.en: bonne journée = have a nice day

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.trans: We went back to my place.
Really work on it at home.

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.note: je n'ai pas de temps; also before a plural adjective: de mauvaises nouvelles

examples.text: Baissez les yeux devant la duchesse!
examples.trans: Lower your eyes before the duchess!
I'll wait for you in front of the cinema.

examples.text: Tu l'as embrassée devant tout le monde!
examples.trans: You kissed her in front of everyone!

meanings.en: in front of, before (a place or person)
meanings.note: devant la porte = in front of the door

examples.trans: I have to see the play.

examples.text: Magali, je dois voir la pièce de Koltès cette semaine.
examples.trans: Magali, I have to see the Koltès play this week.

meanings.note: also alone as an exclamation: Excellent!

examples.text: Nous avons presque perdu une grande star!
examples.trans: We almost lost a big star!

meanings.note: before the noun: une grande actrice = a great actress
for masculine nouns, and in impersonal phrases: il y a

examples.text: Gabriel! Je suis à mon cours d'équitation.
examples.trans: Gabriel! I'm at my horse-riding lesson.

meanings.note: the whole day as it passes; bonne journée = have a nice day
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Très bien. Tu peux commencer maintenant?
examples.trans: Very good. Can you start now?

meanings.note: merci beaucoup = thank you very much

examples.text: Je joue en ce moment dans un spectacle à la Porte des Lilas.
examples.trans: I'm in a show at the moment, at the Porte des Lilas.

meanings.note: Masculine action/result noun formed with the Romance suffix '-ment' (from Latin '-mentum'). Standard masculine noun meaning 'moment, while'.

meanings.en: en ce moment = at the moment, currently

examples.text: On est au Westin. Tout le monde est là.
examples.trans: We're at the Westin. Everyone is here.

meanings.note: everyday speech, with a he/she verb form

examples.text: Oui, oui. J'ai juste besoin d'un petit cours.
examples.trans: Yes, yes. I just need a little lesson.

examples.text: Ça fait plaisir à ma famille.
C'est juste un travail pour faire plaisir à ma famille.
examples.trans: It's just a job to make my family happy.

meanings.en: faire plaisir à = to please, to make happy

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.
C'est comme un rêve pour moi.
examples.trans: It's like a dream for me.

meanings.note: before an infinitive: pour faire plaisir

meanings.en: to rest; se reposer = to rest oneself
meanings.note: First-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are'), the most productive verb class in French. Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Core French verb meaning 'to rest, to relax'.

examples.text: Promets-moi de te reposer ce soir.
Tu dois te reposer un peu, Andréa.
examples.trans: You must rest a little, Andrea.

meanings.note: bonne soirée = have a nice evening

meanings.en: à plus tard = see you later

examples.text: Je voulais te faire la surprise.

meanings.note: before the verb; t' before a vowel

examples.text: Mes amies en parlent tout le temps.
examples.trans: My friends talk about it all the time.

meanings.note: tout le temps = all the time
used alone, after a preposition, or for emphasis: et toi?, avec toi, toi aussi

examples.text: Très bien. Et vous? Un thé?

meanings.note: singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age

examples.trans: But I quickly pulled it back.

examples.text: Et voilà la salle de presse. On appelle ça la boutique.
examples.trans: And here's the press room. We call it the shop.

voilà.gloss: there is; here's; there you go

examples.text: S'il vous plaît. Il n'y a rien entre Mathias et moi, d'accord?
examples.trans: Please. There's nothing between Mathias and me, okay?

meanings.note: il y a = there is / there are
j'y pense = I think about it
place: à Paris, à mon cours
